dataList.content:
Ryōshū and Gregor radiated a burning viciousness.
良秀与格里高尔之间翻腾着杀气。
dataList.place:
Eunbong’s Bar & Fryers Kitchen
银凤炸鸡酒吧 厨房

dataList.content:
Is this… murderous aura supposed to be part of the culinary experience…?
不是……杀气难道也是做料理的一部分吗……？

What recipe are you even gonna show, more canned crapola?
你要拿出哪种食谱？反正也不就是类似于罐头料理的东西？

There’s no dish that beats the taste of survival.
可没有能赢过生存料理的食谱哦。

Hey, champagne hair! Get me a hen.
喂，黄毛！把鸡拿过来。

Yi Sang! Sorry, but can you open this can for me?
李箱先生！不好意思，能请你帮我把这个罐头打开吗？

As you so wish.
如你所愿。

The sights and sounds filling the kitchen seemed at least somewhat proper.
厨房里的烹调画面与声响简直有模有样。

I can hear knives hitting the cutting boards, broth boiling up in pots…
我听到刀切在砧板上发出的声音，汤汁沸腾的声音……

…and fire sizzling on cigarettes.
……以及点烟的声音。

<…HUH?!! Why do I hear smoking in the kitchen?!>
<……欸？！！为什么会有点烟的声音？！>

dataList.title:
Dueling Chefs
厨师
dataList.teller:
Gregor & Ryōshū
格里高尔&良秀

dataList.content:
The two remained silent.
两人一言不发。

Of course, as expected, the sound of a cigarette being snuffed out only came from Gregor’s side.
以及，不出意外，只有格里高尔这边传来了掐灭烟头的声音。
